'''Aaron Steele''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 Tucson tournament]] on 26 February 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d290">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-29-2-26-00-tuscond290/ 2-26-00-tuscon], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 29 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-29-2-26-00-tuscond290/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
